name: Last Night in Jubilee
source:
Last Night in Jubilee is a magical realist visual novel set in Appalachia.

Our narrative follows Lou, a student at an arts college returning to her rural hometown of Jubilee only to find a strange magic settled on the town. As Lou takes a final drive around Jubilee on her last night of break, she is forced to face her own fear of missed connections and making peace with her past in Jubilee to truly be able to look toward her future.

[From [url=https://adelinarose.itch.io/last-night-in-jubilee]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
银禧的最后一夜是一部以阿巴拉契亚为背景的魔幻现实主义视觉小说。

我们的故事讲述的是卢，一名艺术学院的学生，回到她的乡村家乡朱比利，却发现小镇上有一种奇怪的魔法。当卢在休息的最后一晚最后一次开车绕朱比利时，她被迫面对自己对失去联系的恐惧，并与她在朱比利的过去和平相处，以便真正能够展望自己的未来。

[来自[url=https://adelinarose.itch.io/last-night-in-jubilee]itch.io[/url]]
